semantic_requirement: asset-indexed exchange; fee and slippage accounting
distinguishing_test: rounding; reserve safety; net minimum

semantic_requirement: share mint/burn; reserve contributions
distinguishing_test: proportional entitlement; donation and zero-supply boundaries

semantic_requirement: bounded position identity and range
distinguishing_test: fee allocation and finite tick/range traversal

semantic_requirement: claim shares and liquidity-constrained withdrawal
distinguishing_test: insufficient pool liquidity rejects without erasing claim

semantic_requirement: encumbrance and debt-dependent release
distinguishing_test: release cannot violate collateral rule

semantic_requirement: nominal debt distinct from transfers; rate/time arithmetic
distinguishing_test: partial repayment preserves principal and interest allocation

semantic_requirement: authorized seizure; loss and residual debt allocation
distinguishing_test: partial liquidation and close factor; maturity before forfeiture

semantic_requirement: atomic multi-leg settlement with fee
distinguishing_test: every loan repaid within same atomic transaction

semantic_requirement: workflow over old debt, new debt, collateral and signed liability authority
distinguishing_test: reject refinance without old-debt discharge; capitalization changes liability

semantic_requirement: issuance authority plus debt and collateral
distinguishing_test: burn amount and released collateral obey specified debt rule

semantic_requirement: position notional, margin and funding obligations
distinguishing_test: funding signs; insolvency; precise settlement convention

semantic_requirement: choice authority and exercise/payment dates
distinguishing_test: expiry does not erase already exercised payment duty

semantic_requirement: outcome-indexed claims; resolution evidence
distinguishing_test: no duplicate winning claim; invalid resolution rejects

semantic_requirement: share-rate or rebase accounting; loss allocation
distinguishing_test: same nominal token balance can have changing entitlement

semantic_requirement: pending exit identity; custody; delayed completion
distinguishing_test: exit request is not immediate token delivery

semantic_requirement: attested claim; custody and legal assumptions
distinguishing_test: missing external settlement evidence cannot discharge duty

actions_or_workflow: deposit / mint / withdraw / redeem vault shares
semantic_requirement: asset/share conversions with method-specific rounding
distinguishing_test: fees, rounding direction, initial donation and zero shares

semantic_requirement: Pending -> Claimable -> Claimed; residual request amount
distinguishing_test: partial claim and changed exchange rate; double claim rejects

semantic_requirement: bounded workflow of trades, debt, shares and fees
distinguishing_test: losses and debt persist through unwind; liquidity shortage

semantic_requirement: typed observations with provenance, freshness and domain
distinguishing_test: stale or unauthorized evidence rejects

actions_or_workflow: authorize exact plan / refine outcome intent
semantic_requirement: gross debit; net receipt; recipients; calls; new liabilities
distinguishing_test: refund cannot restore gross capacity; fees count against net goal

semantic_requirement: bounded administrative action under fixed claim policy
distinguishing_test: cannot downgrade claims or reset work; affects existing positions

semantic_requirement: bounded pending commitments and finality evidence
distinguishing_test: delayed or duplicate delivery; explicit refund duty

semantic_requirement: operator-specific authority, duties, conflicts and fan-in
distinguishing_test: split partitions work and claims; join cannot duplicate resource
